title: Zephyr: LLSec encode/decode
description: LLSec byte encoding/decoding in Zephyr. DONE
notes: 2026-08-27 completed against spec/02-physical-link.md section 4 and canonical link_frame corpora. The Schnorr frame helpers now fail closed unless the signed LLSec profile is canonical: S and SI both set, E clear, MIC selector 0 or 1, exact 0/2/8/0 destination length for the address mode, mandatory 8-byte signer EUI-64, exact frame-body LENGTH <=254, and overflow-safe payload arithmetic. The signature transcript is the versioned domain including its NUL, LENGTH, LLSec, epoch, big-endian sequence, non-wire DST_LEN, DST, SIID, and payload. Invalid sign inputs are rejected before output mutation. Updated stale focused callers to carry SIID and canonical LENGTH. The isolated C interop consumer drives all 8 canonical signed vectors from link_frame.json and link_frame_signed_modes.json, independently generated signatures, all four address modes, selector compatibility, max payloads, tampering of every authenticated field, legacy/reordered/MIC-included transcript rejection, malformed SIID, S/SI mismatch, encryption, reserved selectors, address mismatch, length mismatch, SIZE_MAX overflow, and atomic signature output. Unsigned canonical modes remain covered by the frame corpus. Existing QEMU RX tests prove authentication before payload publication and replay commit boundaries. Validation: manual Apple clang ASan+UBSan strict builds schnorr48 9/9 and interop 8/8; standalone UBSan/hardening schnorr48, schnorr48_interop, and frame ctests 1/1 each; Python frame/Schnorr/security/cross-impl 171 passed, 14 platform skips; Rust lichen-link std+schnorr shared_vectors 8/8, schnorr48_vectors 2/2, relay_re_sign 8/8 using isolated Cargo target; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 link_crypto 18/18; diff check and scoped cppcheck clean aside from pre-existing style notices in legacy schnorr48 test. No shared-worktree collision.
